title: The lifetime of a decay model
hook: Change decay constant and predict mean lifetime.
misconception: mean lifetime doubles when decay constant doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply mean lifetime = 1/λ to compare mean lifetime when decay constant changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an exponential radioactive decay model, mean lifetime = 1/λ. When decay constant doubles, mean lifetime becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model mean lifetime = 1/λ; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an exponential radioactive decay model, with a nonzero initial result. If decay constant triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on mean lifetime?
recall.why: Apply mean lifetime = 1/λ under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
